## 2. Sandbox RuName

Beside the Sandbox App ID, select **User Tokens**. Under **Get a Token from eBay via Your Application**, copy the OAuth-enabled RuName.

If no RuName exists, create a redirect URL configuration. Use eBay’s standard Sandbox accepted/declined response pages; this app expects the response on `signin.sandbox.ebay.com/ws/eBayISAPI.dll`. The portal may also request a display title and a legitimate privacy-policy URL. [eBay’s RuName instructions](https://developer.ebay.com/develop/guides/sell/authorization)

Copy the generated RuName—not the accepted URL and not a manually generated token.

## 3. Sandbox seller

Create a test seller through **Develop → Tools → eBay Sandbox → Create Test Users**. Its username will start with `TESTUSER_`. [Official test-user instructions](https://developer.ebay.com/api-docs/static/gs_create-a-test-sandbox-user.html)

Keep its username and password. You will enter them into the eBay consent window, not the terminal.

## 4. Sandbox listing

Sign in to the [eBay Sandbox site](https://sandbox.ebay.com/) with the test seller and create a disposable listing with these properties:

- Active, fixed-price, US listing with no variations
- Category ID `183454`
- `Game = Pokémon TCG`
- Current graded or ungraded trading-card condition
- At least two item specifics, fewer than 45
- Simple static description without scripts, forms, iframes, or event handlers

Copy its numeric item ID from the listing page. The listing must be created through the eBay site—not the Inventory API.

## 5. Production keys

Return to [Application Keys](https://developer.ebay.com/my/keys) and collect the Production App ID and Cert ID.

Wave 2 uses them only for a read-only Taxonomy request. It does not need a Production RuName, seller login, or production listing. If the keyset says it is disabled, complete or opt out of eBay’s marketplace account-deletion notification process. [eBay’s production-key instructions](https://www.developer.ebay.com/api-docs/static/gs_create-the-ebay-api-keysets.html)

```bash
cd "/Users/antonioperedo/Desktop/ebay listings enhancement"
nvm use 24.18.1
npm ci
```

Run the Sandbox proof, replacing the placeholder with the numeric Sandbox item ID:

```bash
npm run spike:ebay -- --environment sandbox --item-id YOUR_SANDBOX_ITEM_ID
```

The app will request the Sandbox Client ID, hidden Cert ID, and RuName. It then opens the eBay Sandbox login window and later asks you to type these exact safety confirmations:

```text

```

```bash

```

```bash
npm run spike:ebay -- --recover
```

- Category: **Collectible Card Games**, ID `183454`
- Game: **Pokémon TCG**
- Format: **Fixed price**, quantity `1`, no variations
- Condition: **Ungraded — Near Mint or Better** is recommended
- At least one additional item specific, such as Card Name

Use a short plain-text description. Do not manually add item specifics named Card Condition, Grade, Graded, or Professional Grader. Keep fewer than 45 item specifics.

Publish the listing, confirm it is active, and copy its numeric item ID. Creating listings in Sandbox uses fictional transactions, not real money. [eBay listing guide](https://developer.ebay.com/develop/guides/sell/listing-creation)

- Cert ID / Client Secret

nvm use 24.18.1

```

```bash

```

```bash

```

```bash
npm run spike:ebay -- --recover
```
